name: Arcadeous
subtitle: Own an arcade. Play every machine.
localizedDescription:
Own an arcade from minute one. Fill the floor with cabinets you can walk up to and actually play, set the ticket payout, stock the prize counter and keep the crowd coming back. A first-person arcade management sim where every machine is a real game.

• 59 playable cabinets: 50 coin-op games plus 9 ticket games, original games in the classic 1980s arcade style, drawn in real pixel art, including the fighter DOJO
• Ticket games, a prize counter and a prize wall of upgrades
• Where a machine sits changes what it earns: sightlines, walking routes and neighbours
• One new idea at a time: quarter games, then ticket games, then the ticket booth, then your own prize wall

iPhone beta: an on-screen controller (left thumb moves, drag right to look, tap to use; A B X Y in every cabinet).

versions.localizedDescription:
- Cloud saves: your arcade on every device. Main menu › CLOUD SAVES: type your email, then the 6-digit code we send. No password, ever. Your saves follow you between PC, iPhone, iPad and Android, and a newer save is never overwritten without asking. We never store your email address, and deleting your account is immediate and permanent.
- Full screen on phones and iPads. No more black bars: the arcade fills the screen and the menus stay where your thumbs can reach them.
- Cabinet games show the whole screen. The game was shifted right in the cabinet view and its right edge was cut off (scores, the ends of hints). It's centred now.
- Real racing cabinets. Pole Run, Chase Car and Coast Run now stand in stand-up racing cabinets, the way their originals did: a wheel, a gear stick, pedals on a plate, and nine paint schemes. Customers pay at the coin door, step up and drive, both hands on the wheel, shifting now and then.
- The parts shelf shows what's really on it. When your technician took a part for a repair, the shelf kept showing it until you touched the stock yourself. It updates the moment anyone takes or puts back a part now. (Thanks to the tester who sent this with /bug.)
